pages.text: Washes Dirty Illyrium Dust into Pure Illyrium Dust using water and a filter.$(br2)The Refinery Pump takes water (blue socket) and RF (yellow socket). The Item Hatch takes dust in and gives pure dust out.$(br2)Stuck on a build? Empty your hand and $(l)sneak + right-click$() the controller for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.
